RCO.description: Rating Code Option (RCO). Fields configure AASHTO-LRFR19 PSC rating limit states (Strength/Service stresses, load test, system factor); this is a singleton keyed by id 1 and all fields are optional with defaults.

NOMINAL_FLEX_RESIST.description: Nominal Flexural Resistance method: 0=Code, 1=Strain Compatibility. Applies when SLS_FLEX is true.

SLS_SHEAR_TYPE.description: Strength Limit State Shear Type: 0=Non-Segmental Bridge, 1=Segmental Bridge. Applies when SLS_SHEAR is true.

COMP_STRESS_DESIGN.description: Compressive Stress - Design Load. Applies when DESIGN_LOAD_STRESS is true.

TENSILE_STRESS_DESIGN.description: Tensile Stress - Design Load. Applies when DESIGN_LOAD_STRESS is true.

STRESS_COMPSITE_SECTION_DESIGN.description: Stress for Composite Section (Slab) - Design Load.

COMP_STRESS_SLAB_DESIGN.description: Compressive Stress (Slab) - Design Load. Applies when STRESS_COMPSITE_SECTION_DESIGN is true.

TENSILE_STRESS_SLAB_DESIGN.description: Tensile Stress (Slab) - Design Load. Applies when STRESS_COMPSITE_SECTION_DESIGN is true.

COMP_STRESS_LEGAL.description: Compressive Stress - Legal Load. Applies when LEGAL_LOAD_STRESS is true.

TENSILE_STRESS_LEGAL.description: Tensile Stress - Legal Load. Applies when LEGAL_LOAD_STRESS is true.

STRESS_COMPSITE_SECTION_LEGAL.description: Stress for Composite Section (Slab) - Legal Load.

COMP_STRESS_SLAB_LEGAL.description: Compressive Stress (Slab) - Legal Load. Applies when STRESS_COMPSITE_SECTION_LEGAL is true.

TENSILE_STRESS_SLAB_LEGAL.description: Tensile Stress (Slab) - Legal Load. Applies when STRESS_COMPSITE_SECTION_LEGAL is true.

PRESTRESSING_STEEL.description: Prestressing Steel Stress - Permit Load. Applies when PERMIT_LOAD_STRESS is true.

REINFORCEMENT.description: Reinforcement Stress - Permit Load. Applies when PERMIT_LOAD_STRESS is true.
